spots.name: Ibapah Peak
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 3,663 m (12,018 ft).

spots.name: Fish Springs National Wildlife Refuge
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Black Boy Mine
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Elephant Rock Arch
spots.tip: A natural arch. Low side light at either end of the day brings out the rock texture; at night it can frame the Milky Way.
